work.title: Student SOC Analyst
work.org: Old Dominion University Student Security Operations Center
work.summary: Selected for a competitive two-semester program with a summer internship. I monitor and respond to live threats across the university on rotating CrowdStrike, PagerDuty, and user investigation shifts, triaging phishing against 85% accuracy, sub-2-minute MTTA, and sub-40-minute MTTR targets, and investigating risky sign-ins and compromised accounts in Entra ID and QRadar using KQL. Identified and contained unauthorized software installs across multiple faculty endpoints in CrowdStrike Falcon, linking the activity to an active malvertising campaign.

education.title: B.S. Cybersecurity, Minor in Political Science
education.detail: GPA 3.5/4.0. Focused on security operations, network security, and cyber policy. Hands-on lab work with Linux, packet and log analysis, intrusion detection, and secure infrastructure design, paired with coursework on governance and cyber law.
